turns.reply: So sorry the Harbor 3° Double Sleeping Bag arrived with the zipper torn off! You're within the 14-day damage window, so I've submitted a $179.99 refund request (the full amount you paid) to a team member for approval — items over $50 are reviewed within about one business day. You don't need to send the bag back unless we ask. I'll keep you posted, but please watch for a confirmation from us soon.
